judgment_calls: Maker parts only: board is a bare flat slab with no leather bag, handle or valve, so it reads distinct from prop-bellows/prop-smoker-bellows
Nozzle modelled as unbored octagonal iron frustum lying on its side
Hinge strip is a V-folded leather chevron slab
Base colour carried as material diffuse colour; flat BaseColor PNGs shipped in tex/ only, no image nodes in FBX
All assets under 120 tris; no soft overruns

assets.name: prop-bellows-board-blank
assets.desc: Unfinished pear-shaped oak board blank, one half of a bellows pair; flat slab, no leather, no handle, no valve.

assets.name: prop-tuyere-nozzle-blank
assets.desc: Rough-forged tapered octagonal iron tuyere/nozzle blank, unbored, to be fitted at the board tip.

assets.name: prop-hinge-leather-strip-bm1
assets.desc: Folded (V-creased) tan leather hinge strip for the rear joint of a bellows board pair.

assets.name: prop-bellows-rivet-tray-bm1
assets.desc: Small open pine tray holding ten iron dome-head rivets for fastening leather to bellows boards.
